{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u085/system/state/workspace/programs/task-db113734.py",
 "content": "from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            objects.append((color, cells))

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells in objects:
        minr = min(r for r, c in cells)
        maxr = max(r for r, c in cells)
        minc = min(c for r, c in cells)
        maxc = max(c for r, c in cells)
        occupied = set(cells)
        # A shape is hollow when its bounding box contains an enclosed zero.
        zeros = {(r, c) for r in range(minr, maxr + 1)
                 for c in range(minc, maxc + 1) if (r, c) not in occupied}
        exterior = set()
        q = deque()
        for r, c in zeros:
            if r in (minr, maxr) or c in (minc, maxc):
                exterior.add((r, c))
                q.append((r, c))
        while q:
            r, c = q.popleft()
            for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                p = (r + dr, c + dc)
                if p in zeros and p not in exterior:
                    exterior.add(p)
                    q.append(p)
        hollow = bool(zeros - exterior)
        shift = -minr if hollow else (h - 1 - maxr)
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r + shift][c] = color
    return out
"
}
